issues.description: getSourceMap silently swallows I/O and parse errors on every external frame
issues.detail: The new getSourceMap callback calls readFileSync and convertSourceMap.fromSource on any file that exists, with no try/catch and no caching. A malformed inline sourcemap comment, a binary file that happens to pass existsSync, or a transient read error will throw out of the stack-trace formatter, which is the worst possible place to throw. The value here is 'a sourcemap, or nothing' — make that value explicit and total: wrap the body, return undefined on any failure, and memoize per file path so a stack with N frames in the same module doesn't re-read and re-parse the file N times.

issues.description: resolvedSources path semantics changed from 'resolve relative to map URL' to 'resolve relative to map's parent directory' without a test pinning the intent
issues.detail: The one-line change from resolve(s || '', from) to resolve(from, '..', s || '') is the actual fix, and it conflates two different ideas of 'from': the URL of the map vs. the directory containing the map. The sourcemap spec resolves sources relative to the map file (which is what '..' approximates for a file path, but not for a URL, and not when 'from' is already a directory). This is a value-semantics change at the heart of the module; it deserves a unit test on DecodedMap that documents the chosen interpretation (map-path vs. map-dir, file vs. URL, absolute source paths, sourceRoot) rather than only being validated through a snapshot four layers up the stack.

issues.description: extractSourcemapFromFile and the stack-trace handler are complected with project.vite and the filesystem
issues.detail: extractSourcemapFromFile is a pure-ish value transformer (code string + path -> SourceMap | undefined), but it's only reachable through a closure that also queries project.vite.moduleGraph and calls existsSync/readFileSync inline. The pure core — 'given a file's text and its path, return its embedded or referenced sourcemap' — is worth lifting into its own exported function with no fs and no Vite dependency, and the test-run.ts callback should be the thin shell that decides 'is this an external module?' and 'read the bytes'. That separation is the difference between a value that's easy to test and a behavior that's only reachable by booting Vitest.

issues.description: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns '{}' as a sentinel instead of signaling absence
issues.detail: When the referenced .map file is missing, the reader returns the string '{}' so that convert-source-map parses an empty object rather than throwing. That's a place-oriented workaround: the function's real return type is 'map text or nothing', and encoding 'nothing' as a parseable-but-meaningless value hides the case from callers and from logs. Returning undefined / null (whichever convert-source-map's API accepts) or throwing a typed MissingSourceMap and catching it in extractSourcemapFromFile would make the time/identity of 'we couldn't find the map' explicit instead of laundering it through a fake value.

issues.description: Snapshot-only verification of the fix; no test pins the behavior at the unit boundary
issues.detail: The only evidence the fix works is the updated stacktraces.test.ts.snap showing .ts line numbers instead of .js. Snapshots verify the current end-to-end string; they do not document the contract. A small test that constructs a DecodedMap with known sources / from values and asserts resolvedSources, plus a test for extractSourcemapFromFile against fixtures (inline map, external .map, missing .map, malformed comment), would make the value semantics of this change durable — and would catch the next regression without anyone having to read a stack trace.

review.summary: The fix is a one-line path-resolution correction in DecodedMap plus an external-module sourcemap loader hooked into parseErrorStacktrace. The path-resolution change is the load-bearing line and it changes value semantics (resolve relative to the map's parent directory rather than to the map URL) without a unit test pinning that interpretation. The new loader in test-run.ts is COMPLECTED: a pure 'bytes + path -> sourcemap or nothing' transformation is tangled with Vite's module graph, the filesystem, and an unguarded readFileSync/parse pair that will throw out of the stack-trace formatter on any malformed inline map. Decompose the pure core out, total the function with a try/catch, memoize per file, and replace the '{}' sentinel with explicit absence. The behavior change deserves unit tests at the DecodedMap and extractSourcemapFromFile boundaries; the snapshot diff alone is EASY-NOT-SIMPLE evidence.
